dave-runtime: Observed a 3x p50 latency bump on llm-llama2-70b around 11:07 PST. Happened after chat template change that added a compact user metadata block. Perf profile points at kernel-selection thrash + KV cache churn.

sara-ml: Did token counts change? Could be BOS/EOS or extra punctuation causing byte-fallback.

 dave-runtime: Yes — avg prompt tokens jumped from ~95 -> ~148. Tokenizer diff shows many sequences falling back to byte-level tokenization because of invisible/zero-width chars in metadata. Example: `user_meta = "name: José\u200b; role: dev"` -> tokenizer emits many single-byte tokens.

 maxine-eng: That explains KV cache misses — different tokenization yields different prefixes so cached KV keys don't hit. Also the kernel router is flipping: it prefers the fast continuous-attn kernel for <=128 tokens, but above that it picks a slower streaming kernel. We crossed the threshold.

 ben-platform: Quick mitigations: 1) normalize metadata (NFKC) and strip zero-width/control chars, 2) pad/truncate to 120 tokens in the short term, or 3) bump kernel threshold to 160 while we investigate. Note cost tradeoffs. :warning:  

 sara-ml: Also check RoPE scaling behavior — Llama config uses rope_scale=1.0; longer sequences trigger interpolation codepaths that can force a different kernel when head_dim or kv_head ratios mismatch (seen similar on Mixtral and Qwen).

 dave-runtime: Perf profile top lines: 
```
cpu_time  kernel_choice.c:select_kernel  42%
cpu_time  kv_cache.c:lookup_miss        28%
cpu_time  tokenizer.c:byte_fallback     15%
```

 maxine-eng: Short-term actions: normalize prompts (strip zero-widths), canonicalize emoji, and trim non-essential metadata. Medium-term: make kernel-picker hysteresis-aware to avoid flip-flopping on small token-count changes. Also add a metric for tokenization-mode (wordpiece vs byte-fallback) per request.

 ci-bot: Deploy action: rollback chat-template v2 -> v1 initiated by deploy-bot. ETA ~5m. :arrows_counterclockwise: 

 dave-runtime: After rollback p50 returned to baseline. Filing follow-up: create an eval set with variants — long/short metadata, emojis, zero-width injections, different encodings. Propose routing tweak: add +10% hysteresis buffer to kernel cutoff or prefer the lower-cost kernel for up to N extra tokens if cache hit-rate would be better.

 sara-ml: I'll own the eval set and token-normalization util. Filing PR: utils/token_normalize (strip_control_chars, NFKC).

 maxine-eng: I'll draft the kernel-picker change: smoothing window on recent seq lengths and add a per-model override flag.

 ben-platform: I'll add a runtime flag to temporarily override kernel cutoffs per model / fleet so we can A/B without full rollout.

 dave-runtime: Thanks all. Also reminder to test Qwen and Mixtral configs — their head/kv dim ratios make them sensitive to rope_scale and tokenizer variance. :thumbsup:
